semiconductor_relevance: High — GST CO., LTD. specializes in manufacturing vacuum components, particularly welding bellows and diaphragm valves, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: GST CO., LTD. is a leading manufacturer of vacuum components, focusing on welding bellows and diaphragm valves essential for high-purity gas applications in the semiconductor industry. The company leverages advanced thin plate forming and fine welding technologies to supply reliable products to major semiconductor and related manufacturers.
capabilities: Manufacturing of welding bellows for vacuum applications
Production of diaphragm valves for high-purity gas systems
Development of seamless bellows for gas valves and sensors

regional_presence.Korea: GST CO., LTD. is based in Korea and has developed its technology to compete with global leaders in the vacuum component industry.
